messages:
Maria Gomez: quick q — we planning to run overnight canary in uk-west tonight? need spot quota for ~8 A100 slots for the smoke. also pinging for the TF PR review that bumps the quota.
Sam Patel: i can check current quota now, hold on.
Sam Patel: gcloud shows 12 GPUs free in uk-west for our project but a bunch are spot-preemptible. eviction risk ~30% overnight per vendor note.
Kevin Liu: vendor updated yesterday — they expect a temporary shortfall between 02:00-06:00 UTC. fallback plan: run reduced canary (4 slots) + route remaining tests to eu-west until 05:30.
Maria Gomez: ok noted. if we reduce to 4, will the canary still cover the latency/coldstart metrics we need?
Kevin Liu: yes for basic perf smoke. full traffic sweep needs 8 but we can split into two waves (uk-west small wave + eu-west later).
Tara O'Neill: finance asked about cost for the eu-west fallback. Sam can you give rough delta?
Sam Patel: rough calc: eu-west on-demand ~ +£0.45/hr per GPU. so for 4 GPUs x 2 hours ~= £3.6. negligible for this run.
Maria Gomez: thanks. next — PR is #8423, changed quota var and added vendor fallback routing in terraform. can someone from infra do a quick CR? link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/8423
Kevin Liu: i'll review in ~15m. quick note, check the provider block — we need region alias for eu-west to get routing right.
Sam Patel: small safety request: can we add this smoke-run flag to the rollout plan so Dedicated pools don't get hit? maybe add: `canary.scope = \"regional\"` in the rollout config.
Maria Gomez: good catch. i'll update PR with that flag.
Tara O'Neill: tagging @deploy-bot to gate the canary after PR merge?
deploy-bot: build status — infra/pr-8423: checks passed (unit, fmt). staging apply queued. runbook link: https://runbooks/internal/canary-uk-west.
Maria Gomez: sweet. kevin, if you approve i can merge and kick the canary at 23:45 PT (06:45 UTC). want to avoid vendor short window.
Kevin Liu: approved. :thumbsup: leaving a tiny comment on provider alias.
Sam Patel: FYI i'll watch quota during the run and can flip routing if evictions spike.
Maria Gomez: perfect — i'll add the reduced-wave plan in the PR description and schedule the job. thanks all.
Tara O'Neill: thanks — I'll cc finance on final cost note after run.
Maria Gomez: done — thread closed after merge.
